facts.text: SingleObservation is the OpenAI Gym environment class of the package (a gym.Env subclass)
The action space is Box(2): heading from -45 to +45 degrees and pitch from -30 to 0 degrees
The action space is built as spaces.Box(min_angle, max_angle, dtype=np.float32) from the four angle attributes
The observation space is spaces.Box(low=0, high=255) with the shape and dtype of the first AirSim Scene image
An AirSim Scene image is reshaped to (3, image_response.height, image_response.width); the resolution comes from the AirSim response at runtime
The step reads the Scene image before the physics update and reports done=True when AirSim reports collision_info.has_collided
The reward is 1 when the collided object_name is 'airport' and 0 otherwise
A step advances JSBSim once and returns (observation, reward, done, info)
A reset reinitialises the Simulation and returns a new Scene image
The seed method forwards to gym.utils.seeding.np_random and returns [seed]
The environment uses airsim_frequency_hz 48.0, jsbsim_frequency_hz 240.0 and airspeed 50.0, and constructs Simulation with the JSBSim frequency
The environment's default aircraft is the x8 model
Simulation sets sim_dt = 1.0 / sim_frequency_hz and passes it to the FDM
The AirSim pose update runs when relative_update = airsim_frequency_hz / jsbsim_frequency_hz makes the integer graphics tick increase
The constructor computes max_updates = max_sim_time * jsbsim_frequency_hz, but step never compares id with max_updates, so the environment code has no episode time limit
The default initial conditions are basic_ic.xml; minimal_ic.xml is used only when init_conditions is not None
Simulation.reinitialise resets the FDM to its initial conditions
The JSBSim FDM root is the hardcoded Windows path c:\Users\quessy\Dev\jsbsim
wall_clock_dt starts as None, so the simulation is not wall-clock paced
run() advances the FDM once and sleeps only when wall_clock_dt is set
The AirSim client is a VehicleClient that calls confirmConnection()
The README lists AirSim and JSBSim as separate installs and requires moving the x8 directory and electric800w.xml into the JSBSim aircraft and engine directories

determinism.notes: reset(seed) is accepted and cap.world.seed.v1 fixes the seed of the next reset, but SingleObservation only stores it in gym's np_random; reset always reinitialises from basic_ic.xml and the initial state does not depend on the seed.  JSBSim is deterministic for a fixed state and command sequence; AirSim scene rendering and collision timing are not claimed bit-identical, and the fake is exact for its own placeholder state.

gaps: The clone implements neither the flight dynamics nor the collision response: JSBSim's x8 FDM supplies the rigid-body dynamics and AirSim/Unreal supplies contact and scene rendering (src/jsbsim_simulator.py:83, src/envs/single_observation.py:93-100).  The fake backend reproduces neither; its motion and collision are placeholder test data.

No actuator, sensor, wind, turbulence or noise model is declared: the autopilot receives heading, pitch and airspeed commands and JSBSim applies them.  Contact and actuator fidelity are therefore not validated.
No wall-clock pacing: wall_clock_dt is None (src/jsbsim_simulator.py:89) and realtime_factor is 0; ticks advance simulated time by timestep_ms only.

The fake's observation is a 3 x 8 x 8 placeholder array.  The clone takes (3, height, width) from the AirSim image response at runtime (src/image_processing.py:49) and fixes no default resolution for SingleObservation; the 480 x 832 values in src/segmentation/config.py:22-23 belong to the separate segmentation pipeline, not to this environment.

The seed does not change the reset state: reset reinitialises from basic_ic.xml (src/jsbsim_simulator.py:139-148 and 165-176) and SingleObservation.seed only seeds gym's np_random (src/envs/single_observation.py:81-83).  Repeatability comes from the fixed initial state and deterministic JSBSim arithmetic, not from the seed.
Snapshot and restore are not offered: the environment exposes no get_state/set_state pair.

The hardcoded Windows JSBSim root (src/jsbsim_simulator.py:76) and the separate AirSim/JSBSim installs (README.md:6-10) mean the upstream environment was not run here; only the fake backend is checked.

measures.description: Last observation (derived from the observation space)
measures.name: observation

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: no step, reset or seed is accepted after an e-stop until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch; the last observation stays readable
